chapter: Sam Morgan band: records, slapstick, venues
title: Why Sam used the slapstick
summary: Morgan says drummers used slapsticks and Sam kept time with one; Kid Thomas still does.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: I was going to ask some more about the Sam Morgan band. Whose idea was it, that slapstick of ever using that? Did he get that from the drummer or something? Or how did he happen to start on that?

Well, at that time the drummers used to use slapsticks in the band. And Sam was, had been very sick and I guess that was something he thought would, you could bring Newt to the band, you understand? Maybe not as far as I missed the story. Yeah, no, when the band was playing he used to use that stick. Yeah. And I saw some time back, and Bebe Ridley, he used to use that stick too. Oh, he did? Yeah, when he was playing drums. I know he was playing trombone at that time. Well, Sam used that stick a long time, I'm telling you. The band be playing, Sam reached down there and get that stick, put his trumpet down, and he'd get that stick, man. And keep the time with the stick. Yeah. Sam is the drummer's keeping time.
Kid Thomas uses that quite a bit nowadays too. Who? Kid Thomas still has a slapstick. Oh yeah. He used it. Manuel Paul sometimes too.
Yeah, I'm quite sure he did because when I was playing with him, he used to have a slapstick.
Yeah, they usually hit it on the after beat.
Yeah, on the after beat. Well, Sam had a good band around the city of New Orleans and everybody. Everybody raves about it. Everybody. Yeah, they really talk about Sam Morgan's band.
